Name: Atmos_Fierce Harvey Cosplay Portrait
Author: atmosfierce
Description:
This mod replaces Harvey's pixel portraits with cosplay photo portraits of streamer Atmos_Fierce. After being told a million times I look like Harvey, I decided to start cosplaying him. The natural next step was to put myself into Stardew, so now I am the doctor and he is me. 
[size=5]
Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Install the latest version of Portraiture.[/url]﻿ 
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]the Portraits folder inside the Portraiture mod[/font]. (If done correctly the file would be located at "/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[CP] Atmos Harvey Cosplay Portrait/Harvey.png")
[*]Start the game and talk to someone. Once the Dialogue Box is open press P to change portraits till you see the right one. It will also shortly show the name of the folder above the left top corner of the Dialogue Box, in this case "Atmos Harvey Cosplay Portrait". Whatever folder you pick will be saved for all portraits and stay that way after reloading until you change it again yourself.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]If there are any issues, please reach out and let me know as this is my first time making a mod. 
[/list]
